summary_en: Iwabuchi executed a block purchase of 19,900 shares (1.94% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) at 14,140 yen per share on November 17, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3, totaling 281.386 million yen. This execution is part of a broader buyback authorization of up to 34,000 shares (3.26%) approved on May 15, 2026, of which 14,100 shares totaling 191.619 million yen had been acquired as of November 16.
title_en: Notice of share acquisition through ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange trading
translation_en_brief:
On November 17, 2026, Iwabuchi Corporation executed a block purchase of its own shares through ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange trading. The company acquired 19,900 shares at a fixed price of 14,140 yen per share, based on the previous trading day's closing price. The total acquisition amount was 281.386 million yen, representing 1.94% of issued shares excluding treasury stock.

This block execution is part of a broader share buyback authorization resolved by the Board of Directors on May 15, 2026. Under that authorization, the company is permitted to acquire up to 34,000 shares (3.26% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum total of 510 million yen during the period from July 1 to December 31, 2026. As of November 16, 2026, before this block purchase, the company had already acquired 14,100 shares for 191.619 million yen. Following this execution, the cumulative acquisition under the current authorization reached approximately 34,000 shares as originally authorized.

The purchase was conducted through an off-exchange trading system with an order valid only for the specified trading session. No changes to the authorized share count were made, though the company noted that market conditions could have resulted in partial or non-execution of the order.
